Imitator
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
You must not run!
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Imitator!!
What kind of place is here...?
A-Adventurer! Over there!!
Sir Vatendeth!! H-He's Vatendeth the Dark General\nthat Dunkelis was caring about!\n...What a pity...
Vatendeth is confined in a blackish stuff and\nlooks like unconscious...
Welcome to inside of our body...
Wah!!
Sounds like the spherical object is speaking...
You may think it's a part of the manor that we've\nremodeled but it's not.
It's our colony.\nI mean, you're in our body.
What? What?? So...\nWhat does it mean, adventurer?
It's not the Dark Manor.\nIt's inside the body of the huge monster that\nnested the Dark Manor!
If it's inside the body, it's like exposing the\ninternal organs, right? Then...
Nooooo! I'm sorryyyy!
You've come all the way to here.\nYou shall become the energy of my fellows outside\nlike this guy...
H-Huh?
We formed the colony to send and produce energy\nfor our fellows acting around here.
The creatures in this world are so weak that\nthey run out of life in a matter of seconds\nafter parasitizing them.
It's way too inefficient to change the hosts\nevery time, so we are supplying the energy\nto them...
Their fellows seem to be the black crystals on\nthe soldiers. But looks like the spherical object\nhas little in common...
You don't need to know who we are.\nBecause you won't be able to get out until\nyou dry up like him!
Waaaahhhhh!!
Noooo! Oh? Oh, I know!\nI won't be caught by transforming to the form of\nsoul. Great, adventurer!
You saved my life. Thank you.
Sir, are you alright?!\nWe've come to rescue you under Dunkelis' order!\nPlease get a hold of yourself!
Ug... Umm...\nDunkelis asked you to save me, right...?
It's been a long time since I saw a human like\nyou. I appreciate your help for releasing me...
The unknown monsters... I have no idea what they\nare but... They must pay for what they've done\nto me...
Human, let's fight together!
Ha ha ha... Draining your energy is not the only\nthing we were doing.\nWatch this!
W-What?
I'm glad to see that you're surprised.\nNot only your appearance, we've copied all of\nabilities including power and fighting skills.
We know your attack range.\nYou've got no chance to win!!
W-Why?!\nI've copied your abilities perfectly...
You underestimated this human.\nThis human could be as strong as me.\nMaybe even stronger.
You think you could beat two of us who are as\nstrong as you?
N-No way... Such a feeble living thing...
EVENT BATTLE\nRescue Vatendeth!!
[ff6464]This place is draining energy from you.[ffffff]
